text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm accompanying Kitasan<n>Black to a
television studio for the<n>filming of a New Year's
special.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
They requested that Kitasan Black<n>and Satono
Diamond participate<n>together, as the two have been
very<n>good friends since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what a great friendship you<n>two have. You're
totally in sync!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we get told that a lot!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Which is why we've prepared a<n>compatibility quiz
to put that bond to<n>the test!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Question one! What would you do if<n>you found a
stray kitten? Get ready to<n>answer together now.
One, two...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text: Bring it home! Find someone to adopt<n>it!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oof! Looks like we've got a split in<n>opinion right
from the jump.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you wouldn't want to take care<n>of it yourself,
Dia?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Unlimited cuddles, a cute ball of fluff<n>purring on your
lap—who could pass<n>that up?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, it isn't that simple. We live in the<n>dorm, so I
couldn't take care of it all<n>the time.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Let's see if your answers match in<n>question two!
You accidentally broke<n>the yolk while frying an egg.
What do<n>you do now?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text: I'll just eat it as is! Turn it into<n>scrambled eggs!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I never thought of doing that!<n>You break the
yolk when you eat it<n>anyway, so it's no big deal to
me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's so like you, Kita. I just<n>happen to find
scrambled eggs<n>equally delicious.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay. Our answers were different<n>again, but this
is actually pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, the two continue to differ<n>on their
answers, until finally...

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text: I didn't expect their answers to bethis different. Are we even going tobe able to air this?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And for our last segment, we've got<n>a New Year's
staple—it's time to<n>pound some mochi!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Can these two find a rhythm as they<n>attempt our
yearly mochi-making<n>challenge?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After seeing how they struggled to<n>find common
ground in the<n>compatibility quiz, there's an air of
skepticism pervading the studio.<n>However...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you ready, Dia? Time to wallop<n>this mochi
with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm more than ready! I think it's time<n>to show
everyone how in sync we<n>are!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, then... Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, your attention please! We<n>hope this year
is one of health and<n>great joy for you all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: One, twooo...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hup! Yah! Yah!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're completely on beat! A<n>stark
difference from the compatibility<n>quiz!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Making mochi with you<n>reminds me of the
New Year's<n>celebrations back home.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
New Year's with your family is<n>always so lively.
Your dad's students<n>all visit, too...

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hup! Yah! Yah!

text_block_list.name: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Li'l Miss and Dia are practically<n>mochi-making
pros! They're<n>completely in sync!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia. You definitely gotta come by<n>my place for
New Year's again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I would love to! Let's whip up some<n>delicious
mochi for some piping hot<n>zoni soup!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The heartwarming bond between<n>childhood friends
brings smiles to the<n>faces of the entire film crew.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How about we wrap this up with a<n>bang! All right
everyone, let me hear<n>those shouts, loud and clear!
Ready?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hip, hip!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text: Hooray!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: One more time! Hip, hip!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black rallies the surrounding<n>film crew with
her shouts, creating a<n>jovial atmosphere befitting
the New<n>Year's special.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've seen how in sync<n>you two are,
could I ask one last<n>question?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: How do you like to eat your mochi?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Dia
text_block_list.text: With grated radish! Wrapped in red<n>bean paste!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But you always went for mochi<n>with red bean
paste when you were<n>little, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe this is my palate<n>maturing! But I still
love red bean<n>mochi, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Differences of opinion are normal.<n>And they may in
fact be the key to the<n>deep bond Kitasan Black and
Satono<n>Diamond share.
